name: Wormhole
tldr: The bridge on Solana trusted a fake "signatures already verified" account, so the attacker minted 120,000 wrapped ETH backed by nothing.
what: Wormhole is a bridge: lock ETH on Ethereum, get wrapped ETH on Solana, backed one to one.
happened: The attacker passed in a fake account that claimed the guardians' signatures were already verified. The bridge believed it and minted wrapped ETH with nothing locked behind it.
bug: The code relied on an input that only claimed a check had happened, instead of verifying the signatures itself.
prevent: Verify signatures directly and validate every account passed into a program, never trust one that only says "I'm verified".
lesson: Trust nothing the caller hands you. If a check matters, do it yourself.
